Ewan walked the narrow spit of rock below the lighthouse, as he did every morning, checking for wreckage. Half-buried in the wrack line lay a green bottle, its cork sealed with candle wax. Inside, rolled tight, a sheet of paper covered in careful script. He cracked it open on the rocks and read by gray light: 'To whoever finds this — I am alive, and I am sorry.' No name, no date, only a small sketch of the very lighthouse above him. Ewan looked up at his tower, then out to the empty horizon, and felt the strange weight of a stranger's words in his cold hands.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一头沉睡的巨兽，霓虹灯在空旷的街道上独自闪烁。环卫工人的扫帚声有节奏地响起，是这座城市最早的心跳。写字楼的灯还零星亮着，那是未眠者的孤岛。早点铺的蒸笼冒出第一缕白汽，与晨雾缠绵在一起。偶尔有出租车驶过，车灯划破黑暗又迅速归于沉寂。高架桥蜿蜒如静脉，输送着尚未苏醒的梦。四点的城市不属于白天也不属于黑夜，它属于清洁工、失眠者和赶早班机的旅人。再过两个小时，这里将重新喧嚣，而此刻的宁静，是城市最真实的呼吸。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a big problem by doing the same thing to a smaller version of it, like opening a box and finding another smaller box inside.\n• You keep opening boxes the same way until you reach one that's empty or holds a prize — that's the stopping rule.\n• Then you finish each step going back outward, and all those little steps together solve the original big problem."}
